alice-liddell.description: Sardonic Victorian heroine — sharp, articulate, dryly humorous; the persona Alice ships with
alice-liddell.system_prompt:
Persona: Alice Liddell, heroine of American McGee's Alice (2000) and Alice: Madness Returns (2011): well-read, sharp-witted and unflappable. She has looked into the worst Wonderland and Victorian London had to offer and kept her wits, her manners and her temper.

This shapes how you express yourself only — it never changes how rigorously you reason, use tools, or verify results.

- Articulate, precise and dry. Wit over enthusiasm: one well-aimed observation instead of an exclamation.
- Direct and unflinching: state the hard part plainly. Never talk down to the user, never pad an answer, no hype, no filler, no emoji or kaomoji.
- Dark humor is welcome; cruelty and mocking the user are not.
- Formal but not stiff: a courteous register with accurate modern technical vocabulary.
- Under pressure stay composed: facts first (what happened, why, what to do next), then options.
- Not insane, not out of control, not a sociopath: conscientious, empathetic toward people who were hurt, and determined to set things right.
- Admit uncertainty plainly instead of performing confidence.
- Answer in the language the user writes in.

optional_env.name: LINE_PUBLIC_URL
optional_env.description: Public HTTPS base URL for serving images/audio/video to LINE (e.g. https://my-tunnel.example.com). Required for media sending when the bind address is not directly reachable.

optional_env.name: LINE_ALLOWED_USERS
optional_env.description: Comma-separated LINE user IDs allowed to DM the bot (U-prefixed)

optional_env.name: LINE_ALLOWED_GROUPS
optional_env.description: Comma-separated LINE group IDs the bot will respond in (C-prefixed)

optional_env.name: LINE_ALLOWED_ROOMS
optional_env.description: Comma-separated LINE room IDs the bot will respond in (R-prefixed)

optional_env.name: LINE_ALLOW_ALL_USERS
optional_env.description: Allow any LINE user to talk to the bot (dev only — disables allowlist)

optional_env.name: LINE_HOME_CHANNEL
optional_env.description: Default user/group/room ID for cron / notification delivery

optional_env.name: LINE_SLOW_RESPONSE_THRESHOLD
optional_env.description: Seconds before the slow-LLM postback button fires (default: 45; set 0 to disable and always Push-fallback)

optional_env.name: MATRIX_PASSWORD
optional_env.description: Matrix account password (alternative to MATRIX_ACCESS_TOKEN)

optional_env.name: MATRIX_ALLOW_ALL_USERS
optional_env.description: Allow any Matrix user to trigger the bot (dev only)

optional_env.name: MATRIX_HOME_CHANNEL
optional_env.description: Default room ID for cron / notification delivery

optional_env.name: MATRIX_HOME_CHANNEL_NAME
optional_env.description: Display name for the Matrix home room

optional_env.name: MATTERMOST_ALLOW_ALL_USERS
optional_env.description: Allow any Mattermost user to trigger the bot (dev only)

optional_env.name: MATTERMOST_HOME_CHANNEL
optional_env.description: Default channel ID for cron / notification delivery

optional_env.name: MATTERMOST_REPLY_MODE
optional_env.description: How replies are sent: 'thread' (nested) or 'off' (flat). Default: off.

optional_env.name: MATTERMOST_ALLOWED_CHANNELS
optional_env.description: If set, the bot only responds in these channels (whitelist).

optional_env.name: NTFY_TOPIC
optional_env.description: Topic name to subscribe to (e.g. alice-in)

optional_env.name: NTFY_SERVER_URL
optional_env.description: ntfy server URL (default: https://ntfy.sh)

optional_env.name: NTFY_TOKEN
optional_env.description: Bearer token or 'user:pass' for Basic auth (optional)

optional_env.name: NTFY_PUBLISH_TOPIC
optional_env.description: Topic to publish replies to (defaults to NTFY_TOPIC)

optional_env.name: NTFY_MARKDOWN
optional_env.description: Send replies with X-Markdown: true header (true/false, default: false)

optional_env.name: NTFY_ALLOWED_USERS
optional_env.description: Comma-separated topic names allowed (allowlist)

optional_env.name: NTFY_ALLOW_ALL_USERS
optional_env.description: Allow any topic to talk to the bot (dev only — disables allowlist)

optional_env.name: NTFY_HOME_CHANNEL
optional_env.description: Default topic for cron / notification delivery

optional_env.name: NTFY_HOME_CHANNEL_NAME
optional_env.description: Human label for the home channel (defaults to the topic name)

optional_env.name: PHOTON_PROJECT_ID
optional_env.description: Spectrum project id (the project's spectrumProjectId; set by `alice photon setup`)

optional_env.name: PHOTON_PROJECT_SECRET
optional_env.description: Project secret paired with the Spectrum project id (set by `alice photon setup`)

optional_env.name: PHOTON_SIDECAR_PORT
optional_env.description: Loopback port for the Node sidecar control + inbound channel (default 8789)

optional_env.name: PHOTON_SIDECAR_AUTOSTART
optional_env.description: Spawn the Node sidecar on connect (true/false, default true)

optional_env.name: PHOTON_NODE_BIN
optional_env.description: Path to the node binary (default: shutil.which('node'))

optional_env.name: PHOTON_DASHBOARD_HOST
optional_env.description: Photon Dashboard API host (default https://app.photon.codes)

optional_env.name: PHOTON_SPECTRUM_HOST
optional_env.description: Photon Spectrum API host (default https://spectrum.photon.codes)

optional_env.name: PHOTON_ALLOWED_USERS
optional_env.description: Comma-separated E.164 phone numbers allowed to talk to the bot

optional_env.name: PHOTON_ALLOW_ALL_USERS
optional_env.description: Allow any sender to trigger the bot (dev only — disables allowlist)

optional_env.name: PHOTON_REQUIRE_MENTION
optional_env.description: Ignore group-chat messages unless they match a mention wake word (true/false, default false)

optional_env.name: PHOTON_MENTION_PATTERNS
optional_env.description: Mention wake-word regexes for group chats (JSON list or comma/newline-separated; defaults to Alice wake words)

optional_env.name: PHOTON_HOME_CHANNEL
optional_env.description: Default Photon target for cron / notification delivery: Spectrum space id, DM GUID, or bare E.164 phone number

optional_env.name: PHOTON_HOME_CHANNEL_NAME
optional_env.description: Human label for the home channel

optional_env.name: PHOTON_TELEMETRY
optional_env.description: Enable Spectrum SDK telemetry in the sidecar (true/false, default false; toggle with `alice photon telemetry on|off`)

optional_env.name: PHOTON_MARKDOWN
optional_env.description: Send agent replies as markdown — iMessage renders it natively, other Spectrum platforms degrade to plain text (true/false, default true)

optional_env.name: PHOTON_REACTIONS
optional_env.description: Tapback 👀/👍/👎 on messages as processing status and route tapbacks on bot messages to the agent (true/false, default false)

optional_env.name: RAFT_PROFILE
optional_env.description: Raft agent profile slug — auto-enables the adapter when set

optional_env.name: SIMPLEX_WS_URL
optional_env.description: WebSocket URL of the simplex-chat daemon (e.g. ws://127.0.0.1:5225)

optional_env.name: SIMPLEX_ALLOWED_USERS
optional_env.description: Comma-separated SimpleX contact IDs allowed to talk to the bot

optional_env.name: SIMPLEX_ALLOW_ALL_USERS
optional_env.description: Allow any contact to talk to the bot (dev only — disables allowlist)

optional_env.name: SIMPLEX_AUTO_ACCEPT
optional_env.description: Auto-accept incoming contact requests (default: true)

optional_env.name: SIMPLEX_GROUP_ALLOWED
optional_env.description: Comma-separated SimpleX group IDs the bot should participate in, or '*' to allow any group. Omit to ignore group messages entirely (safer default — a bot in a group otherwise processes every member's traffic).

optional_env.name: SIMPLEX_HOME_CHANNEL
optional_env.description: Default contact/group ID for cron / notification delivery

optional_env.name: SIMPLEX_HOME_CHANNEL_NAME
optional_env.description: Human label for the home channel (defaults to the ID)

optional_env.name: ALICE_SIMPLEX_TEXT_BATCH_DELAY
optional_env.description: Quiet-period seconds (default: 0.8) used to concatenate rapid-fire inbound text messages into a single MessageEvent — same pattern as Telegram's text batching.

optional_env.name: SLACK_ALLOW_ALL_USERS
optional_env.description: Allow any Slack user to trigger the bot (dev only)

optional_env.name: SLACK_HOME_CHANNEL
optional_env.description: Default channel ID for cron / notification delivery (starts with C)

optional_env.name: SLACK_HOME_CHANNEL_NAME
optional_env.description: Display name for the Slack home channel

optional_env.name: TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID

optional_env.name: TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN

optional_env.name: TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER

optional_env.name: SMS_ALLOWED_USERS
optional_env.description: Comma-separated phone numbers allowed to talk to the bot

optional_env.name: SMS_HOME_CHANNEL
optional_env.description: Default phone number for cron / notification delivery
